description: This file implements format conversion utilities for Metal renderer in ANGLE project, including texture format support and capabilities mapping.

classes.name: Format
classes.description: Represents a pixel format with methods to check renderability and CPU readability.

classes.name: FormatBase
classes.description: Base class providing access to actual and intended ANGLE formats.

classes.name: FormatTable
classes.description: Holds tables of pixel and vertex formats, initializes format data, and generates texture capabilities.

methods.name: OverrideTextureCaps
methods.description: Overrides texture capabilities based on format ID and display features.

methods.name: GenerateTextureCapsMap
methods.description: Generates a map of texture capabilities and supported compressed formats based on format table and display features.
